claims.title: A positive bipartition lift exposes precise global-move obstructions for weighted matching sampling

scoped_dependencies.relation: Scoped follow-up to the open general-matching dependency used by N419. This report supplies exact representations and obstructions to several routes, but no general-graph FPRAS or efficient sampler; it does not close or refute N419.

interface: Exact positive lift and conditional-law identities for nonnegative rational edge weights, together with source-reported second-moment, covariance, mixing and sampler-complexity obstructions. No general weighted perfect-matching FPRAS or efficient sampler is established.
limits: The pasted report includes detailed derivations and proofs for the exact lift, covariance/cycle obstructions, and alternating-cycle sampling reduction. Its declared target algorithm was not established. No code, executable package, diagnostic receipts, exact initiating research prompt, or runtime was supplied with this attachment. Correctness, historical originality, and external validation remain unknown.
status: source_derived_unreviewed; independent correctness, formal verification, and historical priority UNKNOWN.
